articles.title: A $1.5 billion crypto startup is taking on Hyperliquid with a Wall Street playbook
articles.snippet: Variational and its investors are betting that the future of onchain trading will look more like a traditional brokerage than a crypto exchange.

articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: Crypto exchanges shouldn’t double as the vault
articles.snippet: A single breach moved billions out of Binance in minutes, exposing how much client money sits with the venue that trades it. Darren Jordan of Komainu argues institutions should keep trading and custody separate, as traditional markets have for decades, and sets out the questions to ask about where assets are held.

articles.title: U.S. judge says Ethereum has ‘no terms of use,’ clears MIT brothers of $25 million fraud
articles.snippet: A federal judge acquitted Anton and James Peraire-Bueno, ruling that their 2023 trade against Ethereum trading bots involved no lie that anyone relied on, and closing the U.S. government’s first criminal case over the practice known as MEV.

articles.title: Bitcoin's 12% slide through key support looks scary, but history says give it 3 months
articles.snippet: Bitcoin broke below its 200-week average with a 12% drop. Only three similar crashes have occurred since 2013. Here’s what happened next.

articles.title: Coinbase CEO says AI agents will account for '99.9%' of transactions within a decade
articles.snippet: Brian Armstrong says Coinbase is building payment tools for AI agents and believes bitcoin has hit bottom despite the selloff.
